title: Minacantalucio
scene: Italian cantautori interpreted as orchestral PDU pop; Battisti–Mogol repertoire
notes: Complete Battisti–Mogol songbook transformed by Gabriel Yared arrangements and expressive orchestral vocals.

title: La Mina
scene: 1975 PDU Italian orchestral adult pop / chanson adaptations and sensual slow-groove songwriting
notes: Orchestral ballads and varied arrangers frame the sensual, rhythmically distinctive L’importante è finire.

title: Singolare
scene: Mid-1970s PDU studio pop; solo-vocal half of Singolare/Plurale artistic diptych
notes: Solo vocal performances alternate soft-rock arrangements and melancholy Italian pop with dramatic peaks.

title: Plurale
scene: Italian PDU studio vocal-jazz; one-voice multitracking into close-harmony and sixteen-voice choruses
sounds_like: The Singers Unlimited|The Swingle Singers|Ella Fitzgerald|Glenn Miller Orchestra
notes: Sixteen-track Mina-only vocal choirs reinterpret jazz standards and popular songs under Gianni Ferrio.
